text:
Devon: RC build ready — candidate-2026-03-23-rc1 created (sha256:fb3e8a9c...). Pin requested for nightshift promotion in the 02:00-04:00 UTC quiet window. Artifacts uploaded to GCR: gcr.io/redwood/worker:rc-20260323. Canaries, KV warm and rollback tag prepared. Asking for ops + oncall signoff.
Maria: Ack from infra. Ran DB migration dry-run and compatibility checks, no blocking diffs. Staging smoke: 95/95 tests pass. What’s the canary ramp plan?
AJ: Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over ~30m with 10m evaluation per step. Autoscale and instance pool already configured. I’ll apply the pin after Devon + oncall ack.
Sam: @oncall-sre ping — can you take watch for the promo window? We’ll kick deploy-bot once you say go. Also note change window overlap with vendor nightly backups (they’re at 03:15 UTC) — aiming to finish before that.
Devon: deploy-bot payload below — will not run until explicit go from oncall and @Maria
```
deploy-bot promote 
  --env prod 
  --artifact candidate-2026-03-23-rc1 
  --canary 1,10,50 
  --canary-interval 10m 
  --kv-warm true 
  --rollback-tag candidate-2026-03-23-rc1-rollback 
  --notify #eng-oncall,#incidents 
```
oncall-sre: Oncall here. I’ve loaded the release runbook and dashboards. Alert triggers: p50 latency > 2s OR error_rate > 0.5% will abort. I’ll be watching the first two steps live. Please ensure KV warm completes before shifting more than 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by Devon. CI status: green. Waiting for explicit approval to start. Link: https://deploy.bot/redwood/promotions/6299999999 :rocket:
Maria: Started KV warm job for top-100 prefixes and cached embeddings. Expect a brief p95 tail for ~5–8 minutes during initial warm. I also staged fallback variant (model:vq4-fallback) in case quantization regressions appear.
AJ: Adding auto-rollback guard: if anomaly_count > 3 errors in rolling 5m window during any canary step -> automatic rollback to tag candidate-2026-03-23-rc1-rollback. Also setting pin TTL = 72h.
Devon: All set. If anyone needs to abort manually: `deploy-bot rollback --to-tag candidate-2026-03-23-rc1-rollback`. I’ll call it if oncall requests. Good luck :shipit:
deploy-bot: Promotion started by Devon at 02:01 UTC. Step 1: 1% traffic shifted. Monitoring 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 passed. Moving to 10% now.
Sam: Good signal so far — p50 and error-rate within thresholds. Moving to nightshift handoff in 20m.
deploy-bot: Canary step 2 -> 10% complete. Monitoring.
oncall-sre: Observability green. No regressions in latency or errors. Standby for final 50% shift.
deploy-bot: Final canary step 50% complete. Post-deploy smoke checks OK. Promotion finished at 02:42 UTC. Release notes: candidate-2026-03-23-rc1 promoted to prod.
Devon: Promo complete, thanks team. Leaving the pin in place for 72h. If any user-facing regressions surface, follow rollback runbook and ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
